title: The ChatGPT/Codex app bundles a full copy of LibreOffice
summary: Simon Willison reports that OpenAI's Codex app bundles a complete copy of LibreOffice, enabling the AI to natively handle office document operations like creating/editing Word docs, spreadsheets, and presentations directly within the agent workflow.
problem_solved: Enables AI agents to directly manipulate office documents without relying on external API calls or third-party document processing services.
why_valuable: This bundling approach allows AI to have full local control over document processing, enabling more powerful end-to-end automation workflows for office tasks while potentially reducing dependency on cloud services.
